Body.Content:
A new command-line tool, odcli, lets OneDrive users, IT admins and support engineers check and manage the OneDrive sync app from the command line. Commands cover sync status, accounts, configuration, policies, and managing the sync app. JSON output lets scripts, management tools and AI agents automate these tasks.

GA date: March CY2027
